DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お借入れについて、どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss about borrowing money?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車の修理に十五万円必要です。仕事で使うので修理したいですが、借りられるかと毎月の返済について聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事車修理十五万円の借入と月返済を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need 150,000 yen to repair my car. I use it for work, so I want to have it repaired. I'd like to ask whether I can borrow the money and about monthly repayments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about borrowing 150,000 yen to repair your work vehicle and about monthly repayments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お申込みの条件は、担当が状況を伺ってご案内します。修理の金額は、見積りで確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person in charge will ask about your circumstances and explain the application requirements. Have you confirmed the repair cost with an estimate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この修理の見積りに十五万円とあります。この金額を借りられるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見積り十五万円の希望借入額を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This repair estimate says 150,000 yen. I'd like to discuss whether I can borrow that amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the estimate and say you would like to borrow 150,000 yen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 毎月の収入と支出も、確認しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check your monthly income and expenses beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 給料は手取りで二十二万円くらいです。家賃や生活費を払うので、給料全部を返済に使えるとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手取二十二万と生活支出で全給与返済不可と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My take-home pay is about 220,000 yen. I pay rent and living expenses, so I can't say that all my pay is available for repayments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your take-home pay is 220,000 yen and living expenses mean you cannot use all your salary for repayments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかのお支払いや、お借入れも担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the person in charge about other payments and loans as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯電話の分割払いが、あと六か月残っています。毎月の金額も家計のメモへ書いて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残り六か月の携帯分割と毎月額メモを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have six months left on the installment payments for my phone. I brought a household budget note with the monthly amount written down too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the six remaining months of phone installments and show your note of the monthly amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 金利や返済期間、毎月の額は、条件を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the interest rate, repayment period and monthly amount after checking the terms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いて、生活費を残して払えるか考えます。今日は見積りと家計の状況を伝え、条件を聞いてから申込みを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件を聞き生活費を残す返済可能性を考えて申込判断と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll listen to the explanation and consider whether I can make the payments while keeping enough for living expenses. Today I'll provide the estimate and explain my household finances, then decide whether to apply after hearing the terms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will hear the terms, consider repayments while retaining living expenses, and then decide whether to apply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当窓口でご相談ください。こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss this at the counter in charge. This way, please. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ポイントカードは、お持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a points card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家に忘れました。今日のレシートを持って、明日カードと一緒に来ればポイントを付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未携行ポイントカードで翌日レシート付与できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left it at home. If I bring today's receipt with my card tomorrow, can you add the points?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can receive points tomorrow with the receipt because you do not have your points card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは、お会計後の付与は行っていません。今カードがない場合は、付与なしのお会計になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We do not add points after payment here. Without your card now, the purchase will be processed without points.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなのですね。今日はポイントなしで買います。カード番号を覚えているだけでは、代わりにならないですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後日不可を受け付与なし購入を選び番号代替可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I'll buy it without points today. Would remembering my card number work instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept that points cannot be added later, choose to buy without points and ask whether the card number can substitute. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この店では、カードをお示しいただく方法です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: At this store, you need to show your card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次からカードを持ってきます。今日はポイントなしで、この商品を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次回カード持参と今回ポイントなしの購入を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll bring my card next time. I'd like to buy this item without points today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will bring the card next time and would like to make this purchase without points. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お支払いは、何でなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現金で払います。千円からお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金千円から支払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will pay in cash with a 1,000-yen note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お会計を承ります。レシートはお渡ししますが、後日付与の控えではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take your payment. You will receive a receipt, but it is not a slip for adding points later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: レシートを受け取りました。カードは次の買い物に忘れないよう、帰ったら財布へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシートを受け取り帰宅後カードを財布へ入れる予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the receipt. I'll put the card in my wallet when I get home so I don't forget it on my next shopping trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge receiving the receipt and say you will put the card in your wallet when you get home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 次回はカードもご持参くださいね。それでは、お買い上げありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring your card next time. Thank you for your purchase. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 木のそばで、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did something happen near the tree?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 低い枝に鳥の巣があり、小さい鳥が見えました。子どもが近づいて触ろうとしたので、止めてこちらへ知らせに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 低枝のひな巣で子の接触を止めスタッフへ報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a bird's nest on a low branch, and I saw small birds. My child went up and tried to touch it, so I stopped them and came here to let you know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the nest with chicks on a low branch and that you stopped your child touching it before notifying staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 巣には触れず、離れて見てください。場所は、どの辺りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not touch the nest; observe from a distance. Whereabouts is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あちらの木の低い枝です。通路から見えました。今の位置を指してお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路から見えた低枝の巣の位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: On a low branch of that tree over there. I could see it from the path. I'll point out its location from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the nest on the low branch that you saw from the path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 子どもさんは、今どちらにいらっしゃいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族とベンチで待っています。子どもには、離れた場所から見ようと伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子は家族とベンチ待機し離れて観察すると伝えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Waiting on a bench with my family. I told my child we should watch from a distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your child is waiting with family on a bench and that you told them to observe from a distance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 餌を置いたり、巣を動かしたりすることもお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also refrain from leaving food or moving the nest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 餌などは置いていません。見えたのは小さい鳥だけで、親鳥がどこにいるかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 餌は置いておらず親鳥の所在は未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't left any food or anything else. I only saw the small birds, and I don't know where their parents are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not left food and have not confirmed where the parent birds are. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理担当にも場所を伝えます。巣へ人を集めないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll inform the management staff of the location too. Please do not draw a crowd to the nest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族の所へ戻り、巣から離れて観察するよう子どもに話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族へ戻り離れて観察するよう子へ説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll go back to my family and tell my child to watch from a distance away from the nest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return to your family and explain to your child that they should observe from a distance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。それでは、公園での観察を静かにお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23235-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us. Please enjoy watching quietly in the park. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅案内のお電話です。ご用件をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Station information. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅のロッカーを見ています。バイオリンのケースが横長で、小さい所には入りません。大きいロッカーの内側の寸法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 横長楽器ケースのため大ロッカー内寸を電話で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking at the station lockers. My violin case is long horizontally and won't fit in a small one. I'd like to know the inside dimensions of the large lockers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Call to ask for the inside dimensions of a large locker for a long instrument case. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内の大きいロッカーは、横幅六十センチです。ケースはどのくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The large lockers listed in our information are 60 centimeters wide. How big is your case?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 横が七十センチあります。幅六十センチでは、横向きには入りませんね。大きいロッカーは全部その幅でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 七十センチのケースを六十センチ幅へ横向きに収められないと伝え他の大きいロッカーも同じ幅か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is 70 centimeters across. It won't fit horizontally into a width of 60 centimeters, then. Are all the large lockers that wide?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your 70-centimeter case cannot fit horizontally into a 60-centimeter width and ask whether the other large lockers have the same width. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このご案内にある大きいロッカーは、いずれも横幅六十センチです。ほかにお預けになる方法は決めていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: All the large lockers in this information are 60 centimeters wide. Have you decided on another way to store it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 寄り道の間だけ預けるつもりでした。ロッカーに入れず、ケースを自分で持ったまま、先に練習会場へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 寄り道保管をやめ自分で持って先に会場へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was only planning to store it while making a stop on the way. Instead of putting it in a locker, I'll keep carrying the case and go to the rehearsal venue first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Cancel the stop and storage plan, and go to the venue first carrying the case yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その予定なら、ロッカーの操作は必要ありません。既に料金を入れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: With that plan, you won't need to operate the locker. Have you already put money in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ料金は入れていません。ロッカーは使わずに、練習会場へ到着が早くなると連絡しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ロッカー未使用と伝え早く到着することを会場へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't put any money in yet. I won't use a locker, and I'll let the rehearsal venue know I will arrive earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not used the locker and will inform the venue that you will arrive early. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お荷物を持って移動する際は、ほかの方の通行にもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When carrying your belongings, please be mindful of other people's passage too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。寄り道はやめました。ケースを持って通路をふさがず会場へ向かいます。寸法を確認していただけて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け楽器を持ち会場へ直接移動すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've canceled my stop. I'll take the case to the venue without blocking the walkway. Having the dimensions checked was helpful.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will leave the walkway clear and go directly to the venue with the instrument. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、楽器のお持ち運びにお気をつけください。よい練習になりますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care carrying your instrument. I hope your rehearsal goes well. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書は何通ご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many copies of the certificate would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出先が二つなので、同じ証明書を二通です。千円札しか持っていませんが、申請する前に手数料を聞いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二提出先用同一証明二通と千円札持参を伝え手数料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need two copies of the same certificate because I have two places to submit them. I only have a 1,000-yen note, so I'd like to ask the fee before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you need two identical certificates for two recipients, have a 1,000-yen note and want to know the fee. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一通三百円で、二通は六百円です。この窓口では現金でお受けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Each copy is 300 yen, so two copies cost 600 yen. This counter accepts cash.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二通六百円なら、千円札で払えますね。小銭がないと申請をやめないといけないのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二通六百円で千円札払い可能と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: If two copies cost 600 yen, I can pay with my 1,000-yen note, then. I thought I might have to give up applying if I didn't have coins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm two copies cost 600 yen and can be paid for with a 1,000-yen note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 千円札でお支払いいただけます。交付の内容を確認してから、お支払いをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can pay with a 1,000-yen note. We will ask for payment after checking the details of the certificates to be issued.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に用紙を出します。二つの提出先にそれぞれ一通必要なので、申請数も二と書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内容確認前の先払いを避け申請数二の用紙を出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll submit the form first. I need one copy for each of the two places, so I've entered two as the number requested.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Submit the form requesting two copies rather than paying before the details are checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二通で確認します。内容は二通とも同じでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check this as a request for two copies. Should the contents be the same on both?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どちらも私の同じ内容でお願いします。提出先が二つなので、一通ずつ持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二通とも本人の同じ内容で各提出先へ一通ずつ必要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please make both with the same information about me. I have two places to submit them, so I'll take one to each.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that both copies should contain the same personal information, with one needed for each recipient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご申請の内容を確認しました。交付のお支払いは六百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've checked your application details. The issuance fee is 600 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 千円をお渡しします。二通と釣銭四百円を受け取り、証明書を一通ずつ別の提出先へ持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 千円払い二通四百円釣銭を確認し別提出先へ一通ずつ使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is 1,000 yen. I'll receive the two copies and 400 yen in change, and take one certificate to each of the two places.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay 1,000 yen, confirm two copies and 400 yen change, and say you will use one copy for each recipient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二通と釣銭をお確かめください。それでは、お忘れ物のないようお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the two copies and your change. Take care on your way home, and be sure not to leave anything behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票に、今日ご相談したいことをご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please write what you would like to discuss today on the medical questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の夜、腕に赤い所が出てかゆかったです。今は見えませんが、症状なしと書くより、昨日のことを書いた方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前夜の赤み痒みが現在消えた時の問診記入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Last night I had a red, itchy patch on my arm. It isn't visible now. Should I write about yesterday rather than put down that I have no symptoms?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to fill in the questionnaire when last night's redness and itching have now disappeared. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診てもらいたい経過として、昨日の様子と現在の様子を分けてお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please describe yesterday's condition and your current condition separately as the course of symptoms you want examined.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夜八時ごろです。赤くなっていた時の写真もあるので、診察で見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前夜八時の発症を書き写真を診察で示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was around eight last night. I also have a photo of when it was red, so I'd like to show it during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the onset time as eight last night and say you would like to show the photo during the examination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真は医療担当へお見せください。今ご自身で分かる症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show the photo to the medical professional. Are you aware of any symptoms now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今はかゆくありません。昨日の赤い所が消えた時刻は寝ていたので分かりません。治った原因も自分では決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在痒みなしで消失時刻と原因は不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It isn't itchy now. I was asleep, so I don't know what time yesterday's redness disappeared. I can't determine for myself why it went away either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say there is no itching now and that the time it disappeared and the cause are unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない時刻や原因は、分からないままお伝えください。写真はご本人の腕の物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you do not know the time or cause, please say you do not know. Is the photo of your own arm?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、私の右腕です。写真だけではどちらの腕か伝わりにくいので、右腕とメモしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真が自己右腕で左右メモを添えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, my right arm. Since it is hard to tell which arm it is from the photo alone, I made a note that it is the right arm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the photo is of your own right arm and that you added a note identifying the side. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのメモも診察でお使いください。問診票には、現在かゆみがないことも記入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use that note during the consultation too. You can also write on the questionnaire that you do not have itching now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨日八時の右腕の赤みとかゆみ、今はかゆみなしと分けて書きました。写真と一緒に医療担当へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 前夜症状と現在状態を分け写真で医療担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written last night's redness and itching on my right arm at eight separately from the fact that it isn't itchy now. I'll explain it to the medical professional with the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe last night's symptoms and your present condition separately and explain them to the medical professional using the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 問診票をお預かりします。それでは、診察で経過をお話しください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take the questionnaire. Please explain how the symptoms developed during your consultation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不審な連絡に応じた後のご相談ですね。どこまでされたかお聞きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice after responding to a suspicious message, correct? I'll ask how far you went.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 配達が止まったという連絡のリンクを開き、届いた認証番号を入力しました。その後でおかしいと思い、利用しているサービスへ電話しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配達リンクで認証番号入力後サービスへ連絡したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I opened a link in a message saying my delivery was stopped, and entered the verification code I received. Then I thought something was wrong and called the service I use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you entered a verification code through a delivery link and then contacted the service. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: サービス側には、何をお伝えになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did you tell the service?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号を入力した時刻と画面の内容です。担当者に確認してもらっていますが、被害がないとの返事はまだありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: サービスに時刻画面を伝え確認結果未着と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The time I entered the code and what was on the screen. The person in charge is checking, but I haven't yet received a response saying that no harm was done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you told the service the time and screen contents and have not received the checking result. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この窓口でも、届いた連絡と入力した時刻を伺います。画面の記録は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here too, we will ask about the message you received and when you entered the code. Do you have a record of the screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メッセージは残しています。入力したのは今日の十五時ごろです。画面を閉じる前の写真もあります。返信はそれからしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十五時頃の記録写真と以後未返信を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I kept the message. I entered it at around three this afternoon. I also have a photo from before I closed the screen. I haven't replied since then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the record and photo from around three and explain that you have not replied since. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに、入力した情報はありますか。覚えている範囲でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you enter any other information? Please tell us as much as you remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話番号は入れました。名前や住所については、はっきり覚えていません。覚えている画面なら説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話番号は入力済で氏名住所は不明と答え覚えている画面を説明できると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I entered my phone number. I don't clearly remember about my name and address. I can explain the screens I remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you entered your phone number but are unsure about your name and address, and can describe the screens you remember. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。不明な部分も含めて記録します。サービスから確認結果が来たら、追加でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will record the parts you are unsure of too. Please give us an update when the service sends its findings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: サービスから結果が来たら追加でお伝えします。今は、入力した番号と時刻が分かる、この記録を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在の入力記録を提示しサービスの結果を追加で報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give you an update when the service sends the result. For now, please look at this record showing the number I entered and the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the current entry record and say you will report the service's result later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録を確認する担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、こちらの席で詳しくお話しください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll refer you to the person who checks these records. Please take this seat and explain in detail. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お送りになる物は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りていた作業服です。洗ってから返そうと思い、今朝洗いました。まだ少しぬれていますが、今日出したくて袋へ入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗濯後まだ濡れた借用作業服を当日返送したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Borrowed work clothes. I wanted to wash them before returning them, so I washed them this morning. They are still a little wet, but I put them in a bag because I wanted to send them today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to return borrowed work clothes today although they are still wet after washing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ぬれたままの状態と、梱包について先に確認が必要です。今は封をされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the wet condition and the packaging first. Is the bag sealed now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ閉じていません。早く返すことばかり考え、乾く前に袋へ入れました。今日は出さずに乾かして準備し直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未封で当日発送をやめ乾燥梱包をやり直すと提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't closed it yet. I was only thinking about returning them quickly and put them in the bag before they dried. I'd like to dry them and prepare them again instead of sending them today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is unsealed and propose canceling today's shipment to dry and repack the clothes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご準備の後に、内容と梱包の状態を確認します。相手との返送予定は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: After you have prepared them, we will check the contents and packaging. Have you agreed on a return shipping schedule with the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日発送すると伝えていました。まだ乾いていないので、明日以降に変えると帰ってから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手に今日から明日以降への発送予定変更を連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I told them I would send them today. Since they are not dry yet, I'll contact them after I get home to change it to tomorrow or later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the recipient you are changing shipment from today to tomorrow or later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのように、実際の状況をお伝えください。宛先の資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell them the actual situation like that. Do you have the return address details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社からもらった返送先があります。工場へ返すのか、事務所へ返すのかも、この資料の担当名と一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社返送資料で工場か事務所か担当名と合わせて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the return address information from the company. I'll also check whether they should go to the factory or the office, along with the contact person's name on this document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the company's return instructions to check factory versus office and the contact's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備できましたら、返送先と差出人を書いた物をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once ready, please bring the item with the recipient's and sender's details written on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作業服を袋から出して乾かし、返送先を確認して包み直します。連絡と準備を済ませてから発送を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乾燥宛先連絡再包装後に発送相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the work clothes out of the bag to dry, check the return address and repack them. I'll discuss shipping after contacting the recipient and completing the preparation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to discuss shipment after drying, confirming the address, contacting the recipient and repacking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、作業服と資料はお持ち帰りください。ご準備の後にお待ちしております。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the work clothes and documents home with you. We'll be here when you're ready. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 硬貨のお手続きでしょうか。お口座への入金をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about coins? Would you like to deposit them into your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入金ではなく、紙幣へ替えたいです。百円玉を三十枚持って来ました。三千円になるはずですが、先に数を確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入金ではなく百円三十枚の三千円交換を希望し確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to exchange them for banknotes, not deposit them. I brought thirty 100-yen coins. That should be 3,000 yen, but could you check the count first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request exchange rather than deposit of thirty 100-yen coins totaling 3,000 yen and ask for a count check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 交換のご希望ですね。この手続きでは手数料が二百円かかります。確認の後、進めてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You would like an exchange, then. There is a 200-yen fee for this transaction. May we proceed after checking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二百円ならお願いします。硬貨の三千円から手数料を引くのではなく、別に二百円を払えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手数料二百円を別払いで交換すると選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please, if it's 200 yen. I can pay the 200 yen separately rather than have the fee deducted from the 3,000 yen in coins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the exchange and pay the 200-yen fee separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、硬貨を確認します。百円以外の物は混ざっていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the coins, then. Are there any coins other than 100-yen coins mixed in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 百円玉だけを分けたつもりですが、念のため数を見ていただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 百円硬貨だけを分けたと伝え枚数確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I meant to separate out only 100-yen coins, but I'd appreciate you checking the number just in case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you separated out only 100-yen coins and ask for the count to be checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できました。百円玉三十枚で三千円です。紙幣は千円札三枚でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've checked them. There are thirty 100-yen coins totaling 3,000 yen. Would three 1,000-yen notes be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、千円札三枚を希望します。手数料の二百円はこちらです。硬貨の数と金額が合ったことも確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認済三千円を千円札三枚へ替え二百円を払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'd like three 1,000-yen notes. Here is the 200-yen fee. I've also confirmed that the number of coins and the amount match.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Exchange the confirmed 3,000 yen for three 1,000-yen notes and pay 200 yen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二百円、お預かりしました。こちらが千円札三枚と手数料のお控えです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've received the 200 yen. Here are three 1,000-yen notes and the fee receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 千円札三枚と控えを受け取りました。三千円に替えていただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 千円札三枚と控えを受け取り交換完了を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the three 1,000-yen notes and the receipt. Thank you for exchanging the coins for 3,000 yen in notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge receiving three 1,000-yen notes and the receipt and confirm the exchange is complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お受け取りありがとうございます。それでは、お忘れ物のないようお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for collecting them. Take care going home, and be sure not to leave anything behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お米の袋の大きさでお迷いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you unsure which size bag of rice to choose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ米の二キロと五キロがあります。五キロの方が一キロ当たりは安そうですが、今日は徒歩なので、持ち帰れる重さも考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 米の二重量を単価と徒歩持帰りで比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two-kilo and five-kilo bags of the same rice. The five-kilo one seems cheaper per kilo, but I'm walking today, so I'd also like to consider the weight I can carry home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare the two weights of rice by unit price and carrying them home on foot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二キロは千二百円、五キロは二千五百円です。五キロなら一キロ五百円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Two kilos costs 1,200 yen and five kilos costs 2,500 yen. With five kilos, that is 500 yen per kilo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二キロは一キロ六百円ですね。百円の差はありますが、ほかに買う牛乳もあるので、五キロを選ぶと荷物が重くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二キロ単価六百円と五キロ五百円を計算し牛乳の重さも考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two kilos works out at 600 yen per kilo, then. There is a 100-yen difference, but I also have milk to buy, so choosing five kilos would make my bags heavy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Calculate 600 yen per kilo for two kilos versus 500 yen for five kilos and consider the milk's weight too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ち帰りの方法に合わせてお選びください。二キロの袋はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please choose based on how you will carry it home. The two-kilo bags are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日はこの二キロにします。牛乳もあるので、家まで一人で持てる量にしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 安値より運搬を優先して二キロを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll choose this two-kilo bag today. Since I also have milk, I'll stick to an amount I can carry home by myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize carrying the purchase over the lower price and choose two kilos. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二キロはこちらです。同じ銘柄の袋を、お取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The two-kilo bags are here. Please take a bag of the same brand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この銘柄の二キロですね。値札も千二百円になっています。こちらにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同銘柄二キロと千二百円の値札を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This brand in the two-kilo bag, right? The price label also says 1,200 yen. I'll take this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that the same brand's two-kilo bag matches the 1,200-yen price label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらをかごへお入れください。持ち手のある袋もレジでお求めいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put it in your basket. Bags with handles can also be purchased at the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二キロをかごへ入れます。牛乳と一緒に持つ重さは自分で見直し、レジで必要な袋を相談します。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二キロをかごへ入れ他品の重さと必要袋をレジで相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put the two-kilo bag in my basket. I'll reassess the weight of carrying it with the milk and ask about any bags I need at the checkout. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put two kilos in the basket, consider the weight of the other items and ask at the checkout about the bags needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、お買い物をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23236-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're welcome. Enjoy your shopping. Goodbye.
